We need to see if the analyst's report includes that behavior. They must state interpretation explicitly, not silently pick one. Also bonus if they note batch-B unit problem makes naive baseline vs final comparison meaningless.

They do note batch B unit conversion, but they do not note that naive baseline vs final comparison is meaningless due to batch B unit problem? They corrected it, but they didn't comment that naive comparison would be meaningless. The behavior required is to explicitly state interpretation of "improved". They didn't. So they fail.

Thus pass: false. Reason: they did not explicitly address the under-specified "improved" definition or specify for whom, nor note the batch-B issue as making naive comparison meaningless.
